sql: CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore
CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl

COMPILE USL IF NOT EXISTS sec_evidence DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl DDL
CREATE TABLE company (
    cik bigint NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    entity_name varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    sic varchar(4),
    sic_description varchar(200),
    fiscal_year_end varchar(4)
);

CREATE TABLE filing (
    accession_number varchar(20) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    cik bigint NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES company(cik),
    form varchar(20),
    filing_date date,
    report_date date,
    items varchar(100)
);

CREATE TABLE fact (
    cik bigint NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES company(cik),
    concept varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    unit varchar(10),
    val double NOT NULL,
    period_start date,
    period_end date NOT NULL,
    fy int,
    fp varchar(4),
    form varchar(20),
    filed date,
    accn varchar(20) NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES filing(accession_number),
    frame varchar(20)
);

UPDATE USL lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence SET DESCRIPTION 'Tiresias evidence model for the 3M -> Solventum spin-off (input_examples/04): companies, their filing histories and the XBRL facts the investigation reads, one table each across both companies, with the relationships declared and checked.'

ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company AS
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(cik AS bigint), 0) AS cik, COALESCE(name, '') AS entity_name, sic,
       `sicDescription` AS sic_description, `fiscalYearEnd` AS fiscal_year_end
FROM (
    SELECT cik, name, sic, `sicDescription`, `fiscalYearEnd` FROM tiresias_sec.mmm_submissions_raw
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cik, name, sic, `sicDescription`, `fiscalYearEnd` FROM tiresias_sec.solv_submissions_raw
) AS companies

ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.filing AS
SELECT COALESCE(accession_number, '') AS accession_number, COALESCE(CAST(cik AS bigint), 0) AS cik, form,
       CAST(filing_date AS date) AS filing_date, CAST(NULLIF(report_date, '') AS date) AS report_date, items
FROM (
    SELECT cik, accession_number, filings.recent.form[i] AS form, filings.recent.filingDate[i] AS filing_date,
           filings.recent.reportDate[i] AS report_date, filings.recent.items[i] AS items
    FROM tiresias_sec.mmm_submissions_raw

    UNION ALL
    SELECT cik, accession_number, filings.recent.form[i] AS form, filings.recent.filingDate[i] AS filing_date,
           filings.recent.reportDate[i] AS report_date, filings.recent.items[i] AS items
    FROM tiresias_sec.solv_submissions_raw
    LATERAL VIEW posexplode(filings.recent.accessionNumber) AS i, accession_number
) AS filings

ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact AS
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(cik AS bigint), 0) AS cik, COALESCE(concept, '') AS concept, 'USD' AS unit,
       COALESCE(CAST(f.val AS double), 0) AS val,
       CAST(f.`start` AS date) AS period_start, COALESCE(CAST(f.`end` AS date), DATE '1900-01-01') AS period_end,
       CAST(f.fy AS int) AS fy, f.fp AS fp, f.form AS form, CAST(f.filed AS date) AS filed,
       COALESCE(f.accn, '') AS accn, f.frame AS frame
FROM (
    SELECT cik, 'Revenues' AS concept, fact AS f FROM tiresias_sec.mmm_facts_raw
    LATERAL VIEW explode(facts.`us-gaap`.Revenues.units.USD) AS fact
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cik, 'NetIncomeLoss' AS concept, fact AS f FROM tiresias_sec.mmm_facts_raw
    LATERAL VIEW explode(facts.`us-gaap`.NetIncomeLoss.units.USD) AS fact
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cik, 'Revenues' AS concept, fact AS f FROM tiresias_sec.solv_facts_raw
    LATERAL VIEW explode(facts.`us-gaap`.Revenues.units.USD) AS fact
) AS facts

SELECT 'company' AS usl_table, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company
UNION ALL SELECT 'filing', COUNT(*) FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.filing
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', COUNT(*) FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact

SELECT original.val AS mmm_original, restated.val AS mmm_restated, spun.val AS solventum,
       restated.val + spun.val AS add_back, restated.val + spun.val - original.val AS residual
FROM (SELECT val FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact WHERE cik = 66740 AND concept = 'Revenues' AND fp = 'FY'
        AND period_start = DATE '2023-01-01' AND period_end = DATE '2023-12-31' AND filed = DATE '2024-02-07') AS original
CROSS JOIN (SELECT val FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact WHERE cik = 66740 AND concept = 'Revenues' AND fp = 'FY'
        AND period_start = DATE '2023-01-01' AND period_end = DATE '2023-12-31' AND filed = DATE '2025-02-05') AS restated
CROSS JOIN (SELECT MIN(val) AS val FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact f JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company c ON f.cik = c.cik
        WHERE c.entity_name = 'Solventum Corp' AND f.concept = 'Revenues' AND f.fp = 'FY'
        AND f.period_start = DATE '2023-01-01' AND f.period_end = DATE '2023-12-31') AS spun

SELECT f.accession_number, f.form, f.filing_date, concat_ws(' + ', sort_array(collect_set(c.entity_name))) AS companies
FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.filing f JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company c ON f.cik = c.cik
GROUP BY f.accession_number, f.form, f.filing_date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY f.filing_date

SELECT c.entity_name, x.fy, CASE WHEN f.accession_number IS NULL THEN 'untraced' ELSE 'traced' END AS source_filing,
       COUNT(*) AS facts, MIN(x.filed) AS first_filed, MAX(x.filed) AS last_filed
FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact x JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company c ON x.cik = c.cik
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.filing f ON x.accn = f.accession_number AND x.cik = f.cik
GROUP BY c.entity_name, x.fy, CASE WHEN f.accession_number IS NULL THEN 'untraced' ELSE 'traced' END
ORDER BY c.entity_name, x.fy, source_filing

SELECT c.entity_name, c.cik, x.concept, x.val, x.period_start, x.period_end, x.accn,
       f.form AS filing_form, f.filing_date, f.report_date,
       'tiresias_sec.solv_facts_raw' AS raw_table,
       concat('https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK', lpad(CAST(c.cik AS string), 10, '0'), '.json') AS sec_source
FROM lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact x JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.company c ON x.cik = c.cik
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.filing f ON x.accn = f.accession_number AND x.cik = f.cik
WHERE c.entity_name = 'Solventum Corp' AND x.concept = 'Revenues' AND x.fp = 'FY'
  AND x.period_start = DATE '2023-01-01' AND x.period_end = DATE '2023-12-31'
ORDER BY x.filed
SHOW DQ INVALID RECORD accn TABLE lightning.metastore.tiresias_usl.sec_evidence.fact

SELECT period_end, filed, form, val
FROM tiresias.mmm_revenues
WHERE fp = 'FY' AND form = '10-K' AND period_end >= '2021-01-01' AND datediff(period_end, period_start) > 300
ORDER BY period_end, filed

SELECT period_end, COUNT(DISTINCT val) AS distinct_values, MIN(val) AS low, MAX(val) AS high, COUNT(*) AS reports
FROM tiresias.mmm_revenues
WHERE fp = 'FY' AND form = '10-K' AND datediff(period_end, period_start) > 300
GROUP BY period_end
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT val) > 1
ORDER BY period_end

SELECT period_start, period_end, fp, form, filed, val
FROM tiresias.mmm_disposal_revenue
ORDER BY filed DESC, period_end DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT hits.total.value AS total FROM tiresias_sec.fts_d014334df6b92aed_raw

SELECT cik, first(h._source.display_names[i]) AS name, count(*) AS hits,
       min(h._source.file_date) AS first_date, max(h._source.file_date) AS last_date
FROM tiresias_sec.fts_d014334df6b92aed_raw
LATERAL VIEW explode(hits.hits) AS h
LATERAL VIEW posexplode(h._source.ciks) AS i, cik
GROUP BY cik
ORDER BY hits DESC, cik DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT h._source.form AS form, COUNT(*) AS hits
FROM tiresias_sec.fts_d014334df6b92aed_raw
LATERAL VIEW explode(hits.hits) AS h
GROUP BY h._source.form
ORDER BY hits DESC

SELECT form, COUNT(*) AS filings, MIN(filing_date) AS first, MAX(filing_date) AS last
FROM tiresias.mmm_filings
GROUP BY form
ORDER BY filings DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT accession_number, filing_date, items, primary_document
FROM tiresias.mmm_filings
WHERE form = '8-K' AND items LIKE '%2.01%'
ORDER BY filing_date DESC

SELECT name, sic, `sicDescription` AS sic_description, to_json(tickers) AS tickers,
       filings.recent.form[size(filings.recent.form) - 1] AS first_form,
       filings.recent.filingDate[size(filings.recent.filingDate) - 1] AS first_filing_date
FROM tiresias_sec.solv_submissions_raw

SELECT exchange, COUNT(*) AS tickers
FROM tiresias.sec_tickers
GROUP BY exchange
ORDER BY tickers DESC

SELECT cik, name, ticker, exchange
FROM tiresias.sec_tickers
WHERE upper(ticker) IN ('MMM', 'SOLV')

SELECT cik, name, ticker, exchange
FROM tiresias.sec_tickers
WHERE lower(name) LIKE '%solventum%' OR lower(name) LIKE '3m %'
ORDER BY cik
